messages:
maya: heads-up from the unified-kv pilot: we observed a transient stale-read window (~200-400ms) on cross-node handoffs affecting streaming cursors. repro in canary.
maya: simplified trace:
PUT prefix -> node A (epoch 77)
EVICT -> tombstone, epoch -> 78
Handoff -> node B claims but cached residency still returns presence until epoch info lands
Cursor read -> returns demoted items
anne: removed sync point in unified path to save an RPC; that introduced the window. not data loss but violates client correctness SLOs.
miguel: options: keep async, re-add lease-refresh, targeted strong-read for active cursors, or opt-in strict mode per deployment.
sam: proposal: add feature flag kv.unified.strict_handoff (default OFF), expose metric prefetch.handoff_inconsistent_reads, run 72h canary with flag ON for subset, chaos test for owner kill during handoff.
miguel: I'll add the chaos test and unit for lease-epoch fence.
maya: perf cost looks small (~0.8ms p99) on handoff-heavy traces; will attach numbers to ticket.
opsbot: Ticket RDW-ENG-9955 created: "canary: kv strict_handoff deploy + repro". Assignees: maya, miguel, sam. Canary window: 72h. Link: https://tickets.internal/9955
maya: thanks—I'll schedule canary and post results here.
